summary: Sound night: measured our loudness (-14.7 LUFS, fine) and found the owner's 2 Nov board change already ships The Curious Plot's mix. I turned the feed's best topics into true stories with real filings (Costco, Starbucks, Planet Fitness, Berkshire's Coca-Cola, Google paying Apple $20B) and added 2 sound proposals.
